svg.text: Formplus: outbound GTM system, end to end
svg.textArea: v1 design from context/docs/gtm-system.md, not built yet. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 2 Route, find the people and get approval

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, personas, signal matrix, playbooks. Only live signals and v1 segments run

1B Buying signals
• W1 Google Forms or paper
• W2 recurring events
• W3 NG school form sales
• W4 hiring (stacked only)
1C New signal?
Skip duplicate

1D Find companies
One Companies table, clean domain, source kept
1E In HubSpot?

Drop
Customer, open deal, suppressed or contacted in 90 days

1F Enrich
• Firmographics
• Page scan for forms
• Payment stack
• Signal detail
1G ICP fit?

Drop, log reason
Not a fit, thin data or outside US, NG, KE

2A Route by segment
• A-US, A-NG schools
• B nonprofits
• D service SMBs
• E African SMEs

2B Find people
Champion first, then economic buyer. Max 2 at large orgs
2C Contact found?
Drop as no_contact

2D Find and verify email
Waterfall, then Bounceban
2E Email valid?

LinkedIn only
Or low-volume campaign if catch-all, else drop

3A Send the sequence
Up to 4 emails over 14 days, 2 LinkedIn DMs, pause on reply

3B Sort replies
AI classifies, drafts for a person
Question or objection
Not now
Wrong person
Not interested, unsub

Trial link or call
Trial: D, E, small B. Call: A, large B

Answer from facts, tag it
Unknowns go to a person
Task for their date
Add named person, back to 2B
Suppress 180 days or for good

3C CRM record
Company, contact, deal on calls. Suppression feeds 1E

3D Weekly review
Reply, bounce, unsub and trial rates by signal, segment and angle

2F Write and QA copy
• Signal line, matched proof
• One question CTA
• campaign-qa passed
• Owner approves the send
Weekly loop: results update the ICP, personas and signal matrix
